notes.title: Patch Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing and reviewing Go! Go! Hamster Chef! Our goal is to let as many people play this game as possible, so passing 50 positive reviews is a huge milestone. Thank you so much!

Here's what's new in this update:

[list]
[*] You can now invert the Y axis to control the camera
[*] You can now control camera sensitivity
[*] Some minor tweaks to dialogues
[*] Adjust trigger timing on Steam achievements
[*] Fix some small bugs involving vegetables being there when they shouldn't
[/list]
Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing Go! Go! Hamster Chef! We've just uploaded a patch which improves a few things that will make your food deliveries more pleasant.

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with cinematics moving very slowly on non-English computers
[*] Fixed some areas in the terrain where it was possible for the player to get stuck
[/list]
Enjoy!
